notes: The openfn adaptor (3.1.3) calls {baseUrl}/api/{path} (default host app.openfn.org) with Authorization: Bearer access_token via request/get/post, so "full" here is every route under /api that a bearer token can reach on OpenFn Lightning. Lightning publishes no complete machine spec (workflow-api.yaml covers 5 workflow ops at a dead /api/v1 base and was rejected), so the 40 operations were enumerated from the vendor router (main 71ce1f0) and API.md route table, and every response/request shape was read from the controllers, JSON views and Ecto encoders rather than guessed. Synthesized as an OpenFn-internal surface: complete because the route table is finite and each row is modelled; field-level types come from source, not captured traffic. Main is ahead of the latest release: five operations carry x-lightning-unreleased, errors are RFC 9457 problem documents only on main (v2.20.1 sends ad-hoc JSON), and v2.20.1's credentials list is unpaginated. Excluded on purpose: the four cookie-session-only /api routes (AI assistant sessions, workflow health) and /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (outside /api). Finding: the adaptor's README and JSDoc examples (post('jobs', {name, body}), "OpenFn v1 API") describe the retired v1 platform; Lightning exposes jobs read-only, so those examples 404. Tool limitation: Lightning wraps workflows as {workflow} / {workflows} with no pagination sibling, so the extractor does not surface Workflow as a data object (it is still a named component schema).
